name: browser
description: Interface for headless browser navigation, DOM inspection, screenshots, and end-to-end interaction testing.

name: communication
description: Interface for team communication channels (chat, comments, notifications) used to report status and request clarifications.

name: database
description: Interface for executing parameterized database queries, inspecting schemas, and running migrations against configured data sources.

name: filesystem
description: Interface for reading, writing, listing, and inspecting files on local storage.

name: git
description: Interface for inspecting git repositories, status, diffs, branches, and commit histories.

name: github
description: Interface for GitHub operations: pull requests, issues, reviews, CI status, and repository metadata via API.

name: mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration interface connecting AI coding agents to external MCP servers, tools, resources, and prompts over stdio or SSE.

name: terminal
description: Interface for executing shell commands, running build/test toolchain commands, and capturing output streams.
